```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r}
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(countrycode)
library(tmap)

```

#Bring in csv
```{r}
genindex<-read_csv(here::here("WK4","HomeworkData","hdr-data (1).csv"),locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                       na = " ")
colnames(genindex)
```

#Filter for 2010 then isolate relevant variables, clean column names, rename value with its year for when data is later combined
#Inspect result

```{r}
data2010 <- genindex %>%
  filter(year == 2010)%>%
  select(countryIsoCode, value)%>%
  clean_names() %>%
  distinct()%>%
  rename(value_2010 = value)%>%
  filter(!is.na(value_2010))

str(data2010)
summary(data2010)
```
#Same for 2019
```{r}
data2019 <- genindex %>%
  filter(year == 2019)%>%
  select(countryIsoCode, value)%>%
  clean_names() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename(value_2019 = value)%>%
  filter(!is.na(value_2019))

str(data2019)
```

```{r} 
combined_data<- data2010 %>%
  left_join(.,
            data2019
          ,by = "country_iso_code")
combined_data <- combined_data%>%
  mutate(difference = value_2010 - value_2019)%>%
  mutate(iso = countrycode(country_iso_code,
                            origin = "iso3c",
                            destination = "iso2c"))

head(combined_data)
```

```{r}
world <- st_read(here::here("WK4","HomeworkData","World_Countries_(Generalized)_-7542350475356456390","World_Countries_Generalized.shp"))
colnames(world)
```
```{r}
joined_data <- world %>%
  clean_names()%>%
  left_join( .,
             combined_data,
             by = "iso" )
```
```{r}
tm_shape(joined_data)+
  tm_polygons(fill="difference")
```
